parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Complete the table to show the substance liberated at the anode and at the cathode. In each case inert electrodes are used.

| electrolyte | substance liberated at the anode | substance liberated at the cathode |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| $\text{AgNO}_3\text{(aq)}$ |  |  |
| concentrated $\text{NaCl}\text{(aq)}$ |  |  |
| $\text{CuSO}_4\text{(aq)}$ |  |  |

parts.label: (b)
parts.stem: Molten calcium iodide, $\text{CaI}_2$, is electrolysed in an inert atmosphere with inert electrodes.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text: Write ionic equations for the reactions occurring at the electrodes.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: The electrolysis of molten $\text{CaI}_2$ is a redox process. Identify the ion that is oxidised and the ion that is reduced, explaining your answer by reference to oxidation numbers.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text: State two visual observations that would be made during this electrolysis.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
An oxide of iron dissolved in an inert solvent is electrolysed for $2.00$ hours using a current of $0.800\text{ A}$. The electrolysis products are iron and oxygen. The mass of iron produced is $1.11\text{ g}$.

Calculate the oxidation number of Fe in the oxide of iron. Show all your working.
